This is the all-new Audi Q3, and Mat’s got his hands on one for a full, in-depth review! 

There’s no denying there’s a huge amount of small SUVs available to buy in 2026, so does the new Q3 offer enough to stand out from the crowd? Let’s take a closer look, starting with the design. 

It’s a bit of a poor start, with the front and the side angle leading the Q3 to feel fairly anonymous. The car we have here is the range-topping edition, so it comes with extra black plastic on the front bumper, as well as a more aggressive grille, but the entry-level model wouldn’t come with these options and would leave a lot to be desired. The new Audi logo appears flat and understated, but thankfully, the sleek headlights lend it a bit of presence.
